body: An open-source workflow automation platform for connecting apps, AI agents, and MCP tools.
plain_description: **Automate business tasks by connecting apps and building AI powered workflows.** Use a visual builder to create flows with hundreds of integrations. Self-host the platform and customize integrations with TypeScript.
technical_description: Activepieces is an open source workflow automation platform with a visual flow builder, AI features, and a TypeScript framework for creating integrations called pieces. The README says pieces can be used as MCP servers with LLMs such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf. It supports self-hosted deployment and network-gapped operation.
title: Activepieces
